evidence.title: Competitor Phase 3 programme in obesity: tirzepatide
evidence.text: Competitor program in obesity: tirzepatide has 17 registered Phase 3 trial(s) in obesity that are active or planned. Lead sponsor(s): Eli Lilly and Company, University of Virginia, Woolcock Institute of Medical Research. Planned enrollment across these trials: 22178 participants. Statuses: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING 6, NOT_YET_RECRUITING 6, RECRUITING 5. Earliest planned primary completion 2026-06-02, latest 2029-12. Trials: NCT05556512, NCT06075667, NCT06162715, NCT06439277, NCT06914895, NCT06918405, NCT06937086, NCT06937099. This is a registry snapshot of trial activity. A registered trial is not evidence that the drug works.
